notes: Total RNA-seq arm of an Hfq CLASH study; strain carries HIS6-TEV-3xFLAG-tagged Hfq (tagged strain -> reference). Cells of the density series were UV cross-linked before harvest; not counted as a treatment (seconds before harvest), but uncertain whether the RNA-seq cells were cross-linked. Only OD 0.4 gets a phase (inferred mid_exponential); OD >= 0.8 in LB left empty. Temperature and aeration not stated.

treatment.q: Cells expressing HIS6-TEV-3xFLAG tagged Hfq were grown in LB medium from early exponential phase to stationary phase.
